reference: Yesterday the candle burned for three long hours.
sk: Včera sviečka horela tri dlhé hodiny.
cz: Včera svíčka hořela tři dlouhé hodiny.
acceptable: Yesterday the candle {burned|burnt} for three long hours.
The candle {burned|burnt} for three long hours yesterday.

mistakes.text: Yesterday the candle burns for three long hours.
Yesterday the candle has {burned|burnt} for three long hours.
mistakes.feedback_sk: S „yesterday“ nepoužívaj Present Perfect, patrí tu Past Simple: „burned“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: S „yesterday“ nepoužívej Present Perfect, patří sem Past Simple: „burned“.

mistakes.text: Yesterday the candle was burning for three long hours.
Yesterday the candle was burned for three long hours.
Yesterday the candle {burned|burnt} three long hours.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Prirodzenejšie je s „for“: „for three long hours“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Přirozenější je s „for“: „for three long hours“.

mistakes.text: Yesterday the candle {burned|burnt} for three long hour.
